description: On the red bedspread in front of a white pillow, there’s a white dustpan, a small yellow cube, an orange wedge-shaped piece, a small yellow duck-like toy with a green top, and a white rectangular piece. The right hand reaches in from the right, pinches and lifts the small yellow duck-like toy, moves it leftward over the dustpan, then lowers and releases it onto the dustpan, leaving the toy resting there while the hand pulls back.
